The '''SKZ Sporting Blaster''' was a civilian [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting rifle]] manufactured by [[Corellian Arms/Legends|Corellian Arms]]. Commonly used for hunting or self-defense, the SKZ was a popular model of sporting blaster for centuries. It was not as powerful as military-grade [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], but it was powerful enough to bring down medium-sized quarries up to all but the largest game. They had a modular design to allow for attachments, and could be easily broken down into three pieces for easy transport and storage.
